mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in private demand, which signals an imminent economic slowdown and triggers negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of a near-term recession and leads to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 215.0 combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS ≥ 0.35%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 800.0 thousand units, coinciding with a decline in the unemployment rate, signals a recovery in housing demand and labor market strength, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 800.0 and UNRATE declines, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 136,000 thousand persons, combined with a declining unemployment rate, indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 136000 and UNRATE declines, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11700.0 billion chained 2017 dollars, observed over a 5-month window, signals a technical recession, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 11700.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
